availability_policy.different_symbol_ends: Report independently, do not drop later observations from a better-covered symbol for comparison. Record each availability end before evaluation.
availability_policy.interior_gaps: Keep requested calendar slots and flag unavailable observations; never redefine a gap out of the denominator.
availability_policy.narrowing: Only provider availability may shorten the holdout end. Seal a dated availability addendum before ANY new-period performance, with requested/observed coverage and failed endpoint evidence. Use the latest complete available month, never a performance-selected date.

classification.coverage_definition: Each period separately: observed daily chains/requested exchange sessions and valid underlying closes/requested sessions must each reach95%. Also disclose IV30, delta and executable-candidate coverage, without replacing missing values or excluding slots.
classification.invalid_or_unrun: Do not assign a completed research verdict to software/data-invalid or unexecuted studies; report NOT_EVALUATED or DATA_BLOCKED. Prior Phase4B evidence stays limited.
classification.overall_core: Both core symbols validated -> RESEARCH-VALIDATED; both rejected -> RESEARCH-REJECTED; otherwise RESEARCH-UNCERTAIN. Missing/incomplete core experiments prevent overall certification. IWM is replication evidence and cannot rescue failed core results.
classification.rejected: All integrity, coverage and trade-count gates pass, and base net P&L is nonpositive in BOTH validation and holdout. Frozen hypothesis then fails to establish positive net expectancy in either expanded period. Do not optimize it here.
classification.threshold_rationale: Preselected descriptive minimum breadth and concentration rules, not power calculations, statistical significance or estimated alpha. Thirty trades may still be inadequate for rare-tail risk; continued research only.
classification.uncertain: Every other completed case: inadequate sample/coverage, mixed signs, cost sensitivity, concentration or unstable regimes. Missing symbol cannot be silently removed from overall evidence.
classification.unit: Per symbol across validation and holdout; overall core summary uses SPY and QQQ labels, not pooled capital.
classification.validated: All integrity checks pass; adequacy and coverage gates pass; base and2x explicit-cost net P&L strictly positive in BOTH periods; at least3 positive realized close-year net trade totals with>=3 closed trades each; winner/year concentration limits pass.

cost_sensitivity.execution: Keep provider observations, prices, spread checks, quantities and all strategy definitions fixed. Scale only explicit commissions/additional slippage. Realized fees and risk/funding fee budgets must use the same multiplier. Cost-driven funding rejections may legitimately alter subsequent positions; identify them, never force equal trade sets.
cost_sensitivity.zero_label: zero explicit costs diagnostic; bid/ask crossing is still charged economically

data_acquisition.acquisition_order: Warm-up and validation first, then quality-audit and seal validation outputs; only then acquire/evaluate holdout, apart from non-performance availability metadata. This is stricter than merely delaying holdout execution.
data_acquisition.contract_reference: Standard SPY/QQQ/IWM ETF options are American/physical, standard multiplier100 only when reference identity supports it. Provider metadata stays distinct from research model assumptions. Nonstandard/adjusted contracts need verified deliverables or explicit exclusion/rejection; never silently assume a standard deliverable.
data_acquisition.observation_date_policy: Explicit single-request date or consistent dated event; provider-created and last-trade timestamps cannot replace observation date.
data_acquisition.provider_model: Preserve request defaults and returned model metadata without supplying invented annual_dividend or rate_value. Record provider method/version and rate_type where exposed. Do not select versions on agreement or performance.
data_acquisition.raw_capture: Preserve exact response bytes and whitelisted request metadata before parsing. Error bodies must not overwrite a valid dataset. No private account fields in manifests.
data_acquisition.request_chunk: One symbol, one exchange date, expiration=*, max_dte=45. EOD quote supplement only if Greek EOD lacks executable bid/ask or relevant metadata. Join exact underlying/date/expiry/right/strike; never use last as executable price.
data_acquisition.storage: External QUANTBOT_DATA_ROOT only; immutable source captures and versioned Parquet snapshots partitioned by underlying/year/month where batching permits. No file per contract. DuckDB reads pinned manifests. Preserve original legacy data.
data_acquisition.tenor_rationale: 0-45 DTE supports ATM30 bracketing, 30-45 entry and held-contract marks through exit/expiry; no 60/90-day or LEAPS series.

underlying.missing: A missing/invalid required session follows the frozen reset/warm-up policy; no synthetic bars or alternate provider.
underlying.policy: Retrieve/preserve one coherent dated adjusted-close history per symbol using the existing provider, including earlier RV seed history. Do not splice incompatible adjustment vintages or use raw spot for RV. New capture, Parquet and manifest are required; legacy CSV is not new provider raw. No future returns in period features.

warmup.policy: Acquire one coherent provider-derived 2022 onward panel for each entitled symbol including SPY, rather than splicing ambiguous legacy analytics into new provider analytics. Legacy corpus stays frozen development evidence. 252 session slots and minimum126 valid IV values are unchanged; missingness may delay eligibility. No pre-period positions.

execution_gates.defect_handling: Stop on genuine data/software invalidation, retain failed artifacts, document before/after defect and tests proving unchanged economic rules. Disclose any holdout exposure; never rebrand a repaired rerun as untouched.
execution_gates.enforcement_status: Preregistration is the prerequisite deliverable. Acquisition/run gate integration and full Phase4C performance/report tests must be implemented and verified before acquisition/evaluation resumes; no Phase4C performance runner exists yet.
execution_gates.holdout_batch: One preregistered batch includes all entitled usable symbols and all three cost scenarios; no subset may be used to select dates/parameters. Open only after validation report and its artifact hashes are sealed.
execution_gates.publication_evidence: Record preregistration commit, file hash, remote branch reachability and check timestamp before the first request. Current code commit must descend from preregistration; verify exact pinned plan bytes.
execution_gates.replay: A checksum-identical code/config/data rerun is reproducibility verification, not a new selectable trial. Compare economic outputs exactly; retrieval time/run IDs may differ and remain separately identified.

existing_observed_corpus.other_legacy_versions: Do not stack daily_eod and daily_greeks duplicates with processed observations.

history_audit.broader_research: Underlying ETF returns through 2026-05-19 were already examined in other strategy research. Future dates here are retrospective relative to specification freeze.
history_audit.finding: Recovered S05/IV-VRP research covers 2022 and January 2023. No S05-specific tuning on later periods was identified in inspected tracked history. Absence of a record does not prove absence of prior observation.
history_audit.unrecorded_research_history: cannot be determined from the current repository

later_data_decisions.additional_underlyings: Only for replication, never select winners after seeing results.
later_data_decisions.additional_years: Only if trade/tail/regime breadth remains insufficient under frozen rules.
later_data_decisions.alternative_analytics_vendors: Consider only documented unresolved model/data discrepancies; no automatic ORATS/iVolatility subscription or fallback.
later_data_decisions.intraday: No daily frozen S05 requirement; only for a separately approved execution/assignment study.
later_data_decisions.oi: No frozen S05 requirement; do not buy merely to add a filter.
later_data_decisions.quote_sizes: Needed for future capacity claims; one-lot study cannot certify liquidity without them.
later_data_decisions.rates_dividends: Not required for provider-only S05 signals; needed for independent analytic validation and assignment/dividend questions, not a Phase4C excuse for substituting IV.

metrics.additional_slippage: Explicit multi-leg penalty charged once, USD; spread remains in fills.
metrics.average_and_max_defined_risk: Both across all daily states and occupied states; empty groups null. Track actual-event maxima too.
metrics.by_calendar_year: Equity-change P&L including open marks, turnover, costs, entries/closed trades, drawdown and exposure on continuous period ledger; separate close-year realized trade attribution.
metrics.by_underlying: Separate funded ledgers; never sum into an invented allocation.
metrics.capacity: Quote size supplied/missing by leg; no capacity claim or new filter.
metrics.completed_trades: Actual atomic entry and close/expiry; terminal-forced closes separately.
metrics.concentration: Largest and five largest winners / sum positive trade P&L; largest losses / sum abs negative P&L; positive-year share and pairwise symbol comparisons. Null when denominator zero.
metrics.eligible_decision_dates: Count all daily and first-session-of-week dates passing frozen warm-up/data requirements separately.
metrics.entry_conditions: Decision/fill date, provider IV30, RV, spread, percentile, actual short deltas/strikes/DTE, width, gross credit, full identities and actual risk.
metrics.exit_reasons: All observed triggers and primary reason, next-observation fill, rejected retries, terminal/expiry flag.
metrics.expectancy: Mean completed net trade P&L; null when no trades.
metrics.gross_and_net_pnl: Executed premium cash flows, explicit commissions, additional slippage and marked/open P&L separately; net equals equity change.
metrics.gross_premium_turnover: Sum abs(executed qty*price*multiplier) / initial capital; excludes nonexistent expiry trade turnover.
metrics.max_drawdown: Equity / running peak including initial cash minus1; negative fraction.
metrics.max_simultaneous_defined_risk: Maximum sum of open gross defined losses and fee-inclusive budgets, with post-fill event states included even if closed before EOD.
metrics.missingness_impact: Requested/observed/feature-eligible/candidate/submitted/executed counts. Never simulate missing trades to claim a counterfactual profit.
metrics.regime_diagnostics: At entry, sign of trailing63-session adjusted-close return (up>=0/down<0/unavailable); IV percentile band70-to-below85 or85-to100. Descriptive only, no new filter or parameter selection. Report sample sizes and overlap.
metrics.rejections_by_reason: Entry/close, data/risk/funding/quote gates; retries are attempts, not new trades.
metrics.return_on_research_capital: Net P&L / initial100000 for each independent ledger.
metrics.return_on_risk_deployed: Completed-trade net P&L / sum of their actual-entry fee-inclusive defined risk. Reused capital denominator, not annualized return or a portfolio capital return. Also show gross-loss-only denominator.
metrics.selected_condors: Four valid selected identities before submission; report selection failure reasons.
metrics.submitted_entries: Actual entry order attempts; executed entries separately.
metrics.threshold_signals: Daily and weekly IV30/RV/percentile gate counts, including unavailable-feature reasons.
metrics.trade_duration: Calendar days and exchange sessions, min/median/max/quantiles; entry and exit dates recorded.
metrics.win_loss_distribution: Net trade P&L; winners>0, losers<0, flat=0; counts/fractions, mean winner/loser, median and quantiles, null for empty groups.

outputs.generated_ignored: runs/phase4c/<unique-run-id> for reports, equity, signals, trades, costs, risks, orders, rejections and sealed run manifests; never overwrite old outputs.
outputs.market_data: External data root only; no credentials, machine-specific absolute paths, CSV/Parquet market data or databases in Git.
outputs.small_tracked: research/phase4c/s05-v1 plan, availability/verification metadata, documentation/report definitions only

period_execution.boundary_policy: Use existing normal executable terminal close convention at each declared end; report terminal-forced trades separately, including counts and P&L. No favorable midpoint or post-boundary observation is imported. If normal close is impossible, report the run incomplete.
period_execution.causality: Signals/exits at observation t, atomic fill only at a later permitted observation; no same-day signal/entry or artificial open from EOD data.
period_execution.no_strategy_changes: Thresholds, IV30, EWMA, percentile, weekly cadence, strikes/wings, exits, one-lot sizing, capital and hard risk limits remain frozen.
period_execution.reset_policy: Start each validation and holdout ledger flat with frozen initial capital; seed trailing indicators causally from preceding history. No pending validation order or position crosses into holdout.
period_execution.within_period_years: Calendar-year reports slice the continuous period ledger and preserve equity carry and open marks. Do not restart each year.

quality_audit.missing_observations: Flag every requested slot; do not discard unfavorable periods. Missing IV/delta or unavailable tenor prevents candidates under frozen rules. Do not change one-leg atomic policy.
quality_audit.usable_segment_definition: Report per date both feature eligibility and candidate executability; no P&L-based selection. Data deficiencies can make the experiment incomplete/uncertain, not evidence against the strategy.

remaining_model_limits: American physical contracts use historical intrinsic/cash research settlement; no full early assignment engine.
EOD observations are not intraday synchronized executable quotes or a capacity guarantee.
Provider Greeks/IV remain provider-derived and may change with vendor methodology; no local-IV fallback.
No event/panic/OI filter, gamma scalping, intraday hedge, financing or cash yield is added.
One contract and100000 capital can produce tiny capital returns; positive expectancy alone is not commercial viability.
Previously observed regimes and multiple strategy research variants preclude proof of alpha.

symbols.extension_authority: Phase 4C user request explicitly authorizes IWM if entitled; Phase 4B immutable universe remains unchanged.
symbols.spy_only: Allowed as a clearly labeled partial SPY replication with identical periods/rules; cannot certify the requested multi-symbol study or rescue unavailable QQQ.
